The Drowned Observatory

The observatory drowned a thousand years ago, but its six beacons still remember the sun. Sail the shallow sea, gather the drifting sunmotes, and kindle every beacon. Each flame pushes the water back and holds the sun above the horizon — keep the light until dawn, before the dusk takes the sea.

GATHERSunmotes ride the swell. Chain them fast for combo score.
CARRYYour hold fits 12. Follow the amber needle on the chart.
KINDLESail close to a dark beacon — it drinks the motes from your hold.
